description: This file defines a deterministic, offline AI authoring utility to generate test steps from user prompts for use in automated testing. It contains a primary function generate_suggested_steps, which analyzes input prompts and context to produce a structured sequence of test actions and rationales, designed to be consistent and predictable without external API calls.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] generate_suggested_steps(prompt: str, context: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Produces a structured set of suggested test steps and a rationale based on a user prompt and context, using a deterministic template and heuristic analysis.

methods.name: List[str] _tokenize(text: str)
methods.description: Tokenizes input text into a lowercase list of tokens, replacing punctuation with spaces for consistent splitting.

methods.name: str _detect_target_hint(tokens: List[str], context: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Attempts to identify a target page or entity based on context or tokens, prioritizing context keys before token matching.

methods.name: Any _extract_data_hint(tokens: List[str])
methods.description: Derives deterministic input data hints based on tokens, such as login credentials or search queries.

methods.name: str _derive_expected_outcome(prompt: str)
methods.description: Creates a deterministic expected outcome string based on prompt content, indicating what successful test completion looks like.

methods.name: str _build_rationale(prompt: str, target_hint: str, context: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Constructs a concise, deterministic explanation of how the generated steps relate to the input prompt and context.
